faq.heading: What is available on the AI generator page today

items.question: Does this page generate a video today?
items.answer: No. It previews the planned interface and does not call an AI generation provider.

items.question: Is my prompt submitted anywhere?
items.answer: No. The preview keeps the prompt in the current browser session.

items.question: Do the ratio and duration controls create a job?
items.answer: No. They are visual previews until a production provider is integrated and verified.
